SELECT DISTINCT A.ACCT_NO id, B.SEC_ACCT_NAME text FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT A INNER JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO B ON A.ACCT_NO = B.SEC_ACCT_ID
1 = 1
AND ( A.ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR B.SEC_ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND A.ACCT_NO = #{initValue}

SELECT A.CASH_TYPE_1 cashType1, B.VDATE vdate, B.MDATE mdate, B.VDATE_UNADJUST vdateUnadjust, B.MDATE_UNADJUST mdateUnadjust, B.PRIN_AMT prinAmt, B.INT_AMT intAmt, B.IS_PAY_INT isPayInt FROM FIN_CASH_INFO A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN B ON A.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND A.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
select inv_aim from ( select t.inv_aim from ETR_ENTRUST t where t.entrust_type='06' order by t.update_time desc ) where rownum =1

select r.type_6 from FIN_PRODUCT t left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD v on t.finprod_id = v.finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE r on t.finprod_id = r.finprod_id
and t.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
SELECT T.ENTRUST_ID, T.TRADER FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE T WHERE T.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM MST_FUND_MARKET_INFO a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.FUND_CODE = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.FUND_CODE = #{secId} and a.VALUE_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM INTERF_F_MARKET_INFO a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.FUND_CODE = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.FUND_CODE = #{secId} and a.VALUE_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM MST_SHARE_PRICE a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.SHARES_ID = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.SHARES_ID = #{secId} and a.DEAL_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1

SELECT a.CLOSE_PRICE as price FROM INTERF_STOCK_QUOTE a INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT c ON a.STOCK_COOD = c.FINPROD_MARKET_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.STOCK_COOD = #{secId} and a.TRADE_DATE = to_date(#{date},'yyyy-MM-dd') - 1
